concept_uz: Rishtonlik kulol Malika opa juda mustahkam yangi sir ixtiro qildi. Yuz tokchali javon bor, sinov kosasi esa atigi ikkita: kosa qaysi tokchadan sinishini aniq topish kerak. Shogird Sardor ikki yoʻl taklif qiladi, ikkalasi ham uzoq. Video savol bilan toʻxtaydi: eng yomon holatda ham yetadigan eng kam tashlashlar soni nechta?

facts.claim: Javon 100 tokchali, tokchalar pastdan 1 dan 100 gacha; sinov kosasi faqat ikkita
Bir tokchadan sinadigan kosa undan baland har qanday tokchadan ham sinadi; butun qolgan kosani yana tashlash mumkin
Bitta kosa bilan 100 martagacha tashlash kerak boʻladi
Javob (14) bu videoda AYTILMAYDI: 18-jumboq 1-raundda, 2026-10-05 da ochilgan, javob 2026-10-12 da ochiladi

style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, warm late-afternoon light, rich cobalt-blue and turquoise Rishton ceramic colours against warm clay and plaster, soft dust in sunbeams, expressive characters, gentle comedy. No text, no letters, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide shot of a sunny pottery courtyard in Rishton, Fergana Valley: a clay kiln, shelves of cobalt-blue and turquoise glazed plates, a potter's wheel, a grape vine overhead, and in the centre a VERY tall narrow wooden test tower with many thin numbered-looking shelves (no visible digits) rising high above a flat grey stone floor, with a wooden ladder leaning on it. No people.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character of an Uzbek woman potter about forty, kind clever eyes, a dark INDIGO headscarf with small white dots tied at the back, a long earth-brown dress, a canvas apron with turquoise glaze smudges, sleeves rolled up, clay on her fingers, standing confidently with a slight smile.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character of an Uzbek boy about twelve, big eager eyes, a black-and-white chust skullcap (doppi), an orange shirt with rolled sleeves, a smear of clay on his LEFT cheek, sneakers, bouncing on his toes with excitement.

Vertical 9:16 close-up of exactly two identical ceramic bowls side by side on a folded white cloth: deep cobalt-blue glaze with a white and turquoise Rishton floral pattern and a thin golden rim, very glossy. Warm light, shallow depth of field. No people.

Combine the attached images into one vertical 9:16 shot in the same courtyard: the potter stands at the foot of the tall test tower holding one blue bowl in each hand; the boy stands beside her looking up at the top of the tower with his mouth open. Exactly two bowls. Same faces, same clothes, same light.

Change the scene: the potter now stands high on the wooden ladder halfway up the tall tower, holding ONE blue bowl out at arm's length over the stone floor; far below, the boy covers his ears and squints. The second bowl rests safely on a cloth on the ground. Low camera angle looking up. Same faces, 9:16.

Change the scene: blue ceramic shards lie on the stone floor at the foot of the tower; the potter holds the ONE remaining bowl protectively against her apron; the boy kneels by the shards with both hands on his head. Same faces, same light, 9:16.

scenes.prompt: The potter lets go of the bowl; it falls in slow motion past the shelves and hits the stone floor with a loud ringing CLANG, bounces once and spins to a stop — unbroken. The boy peeks through his fingers. Audio: whoosh, ringing clang, spinning wobble. The woman shouts down in Uzbek with a warm, confident female voice, about forty, patient and a little teasing, delighted: "Butun qoldi! Sirim haqiqatan mustahkam!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Lekin qaysi tokchadan sinadi? Shuni aniq bilishim kerak.

scenes.prompt: Medium shot. The potter turns one glossy blue bowl in her hands, taps the rim and listens to its ring, then narrows her eyes thoughtfully. Audio: a clear ceramic ping, courtyard birds. She says in Uzbek with a warm, confident female voice, about forty, patient and a little teasing: "Lekin qaysi tokchadan sinadi? Shuni aniq bilishim kerak." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Yuzta tokcha. Kosa esa atigi ikkita. Ikkalasi sinsa, sinov tugaydi.

scenes.prompt: Slow vertical tilt from the stone floor all the way up the tall tower to its top shelf, then back down to the potter, who raises the two bowls one after the other. Audio: a long rising whistle as the camera climbs, then a soft thud. She says in Uzbek with a warm, confident female voice, about forty, patient and a little teasing, serious: "Yuzta tokcha. Kosa esa atigi ikkita. Ikkalasi sinsa, sinov tugaydi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Oson-ku! Birinchi tokchadan boshlab, bittadan yuqoriga chiqamiz!

scenes.prompt: The boy bounces with excitement, points at the lowest shelf, then mimes climbing step by step up an invisible staircase, faster and faster. Audio: quick comic footsteps, a little musical run. He says in Uzbek with a bright, eager boy's voice, about twelve, eager: "Oson-ku! Birinchi tokchadan boshlab, bittadan yuqoriga chiqamiz!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Unda yuz marta tashlashga toʻgʻri kelishi mumkin. Kechgacha shu yerda turamiz.

scenes.prompt: Medium two-shot. The potter crosses her arms and gives the boy a patient look; the boy's shoulders drop and he slumps dramatically onto a bench. Audio: a slow comic deflating trombone note, a sigh. She says in Uzbek with a warm, confident female voice, about forty, patient and a little teasing, gently teasing: "Unda yuz marta tashlashga to'g'ri kelishi mumkin. Kechgacha shu yerda turamiz." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Unda oʻntadan sakraymiz! Sinsa, pastini bittadan tekshiramiz.
Yaxshi fikr... lekin bundan ham kam boʻladi.

scenes.prompt: The boy jumps up from beside the shards with a new idea, counting on his fingers by tens; the potter, holding the last bowl, smiles and slowly shakes her head. Audio: a light 'ding' of an idea, ceramic shards clinking. The boy says in Uzbek with a bright, eager boy's voice, about twelve: "Unda o'ntadan sakraymiz! Sinsa, pastini bittadan tekshiramiz." The woman answers in Uzbek with a warm, confident female voice, about forty, patient and a little teasing, smiling: "Yaxshi fikr... lekin bundan ham kam bo'ladi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Eng yomon holatda ham albatta yetadigan eng kam tashlashlar soni nechta? Javobni izohda yozing!
